name: Prophesying
overview: Prophesying in Scripture is a divinely ordained activity where God's Spirit empowers chosen individuals to declare His words and purposes, as seen when the Spirit was given to the seventy elders causing them to prophesy (Numbers 11:25). Prophets are set apart by God for this task even before birth, commissioned to speak His truth to the nations (Jeremiah 1:5). This gift continues into the New Testament era with the promise of the Spirit being poured out on all believers, enabling sons, daughters, and all ages to prophesy (Joel 2:28). Through prophecy, God reveals His secret plans and calls His people to hear and obey His word, exemplified in commands to prophesy to dry bones as a sign of His life-giving power (Ezekiel 37:4; Amos 3:7). Ultimately, the prophetic message points to Christ, the Wonderful Counselor and Prince of Peace, through whom God's government and salvation are established (Isaiah 9:6).
